messages:
anna_marketing: Heads-up — iterating on the competitive battlecard for next week's webinar. Need crisp counters vs cloud AI platforms, pure LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Goals: 90s elevator, 3 objection responses, 2 pricing slides. Who can own which section? @kevin_product @sanjay_sales
kevin_product: I can take cloud AI platforms. Angle: predictable latency + fallbacks + cost controls. I’ll need SLO numbers and a short microbenchmark we can cite.
sanjay_sales: I'll handle buyer objections: 'we use managed endpoints', 'we own models', 'we self-host to save $' — will draft 3 rebuttals per objection.
lena_research: I have perf numbers from last month: 99th pct latency, cost per 1M tokens vs major endpoints. Posting link in a sec.
mike_design: I’ll tighten the one-pager and slides. Suggest a 3-column layout: Claim / Proof / Rebuttal. Keep visuals minimal.
olivia_ops: Add a section on Private (VPC/on‑prem) — that's a dealmaker for regulated customers; include KMS/HSM and audit log bullets.
ben_jr_se: Can someone add a tiny config snippet for routing policy we can show on a slide? e.g. `route: region=>us, tier=>dedicated, fallback=>hosted`
anna_marketing: Messaging note: lead with 'production economics' then the unified runtime. Avoid raw 'we're cheaper' claims — show levers (batching, cache, quantization) + measurable impact.
sanjay_sales: Re objection 'cloud vendor gives discounts' — quick reply: 'discounts + usage variability = unpredictable latency & egress costs; we give controls to keep unit economics predictable.'
lena_research: Posting mock bench link: https://tiny.redwood/bench-1749 — top-line: dedicated 40% lower $/token at p95, hosted 2x faster tail latency vs generic endpoints. Use as an attribution: 'internal benchmark, mm/yy'.
mike_design: Draft slide uploaded: https://drive.redwood/slides/battle-v2 — feedback welcome. Note: infra vendor slide is too copy-heavy rn.
anna_marketing: Also need: 1 tweet, 2 LinkedIn posts, and quick webinar registration copy. We should A/B test two headline frames: 'Production economics' vs 'Unified runtime for every deployment'.
kevin_product: I'll write the tweet + two short CTAs. Draft tweet: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost — Redwood Inference unifies hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Join our webinar 4/6.'
olivia_ops: Security bullets to include: VPC peering, KMS/HSM, audit trails, SOC2 logs. Keep each to a single short line.
ben_jr_se: We have a customer quote: 'switched to Redwood, 3x fewer timeouts' — can we anonymize and include that in the one-pager?
anna_marketing: Need legal clearance for the quote + bench claims. @sanjay_sales can you route to legal and drop the verdict here?
sanjay_sales: On it — I'll ping legal and update this thread with approval or required edits.
event-bot: Calendar invite sent: Battlecard sync 2025-04-01 10:00 PT — organizers: anna_marketing, kevin_product
anna_marketing: Thanks all — assigning owners: @kevin_product (cloud platforms), @sanjay_sales (buyer objections & legal), @lena_research (bench details), @mike_design (slides), @olivia_ops (security/private), @ben_jr_se (customer examples). I’ll compile and circulate a v2 by 03/31. :thumbsup:
